prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【IELTS Task 1 特例段 / 论文实验反常现象（Anomalous Observation）剖析段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想在图表或实验结果段中，专门挑出违背总体规律的 1–2 个异常点（Outliers）或局部反常尖峰进行精准描述与成因剖析。”。请严格按照 `BP32` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L002`（平行主位推进模式（Constant Theme Progression）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Most datasets follow this rule, except Exchange dataset. On Exchange dataset, deep models are worse than simple linear models. This is because financial data has strong random walk noise.
structural_constraints: S1 [总体规律背景下的特例锚定 Outlier Identification]：Although [General Trend holds across most groups/steps], a notable departure from this pattern occurs in [Specific Point/Group].
S2 [反常幅度量化 Quantitative Deviation]：Whereas peer categories cluster tightly within $[A, B]$, [Outlier Entity] spikes/drops to [Extreme Value], deviating by more than [X%] from the group median.
S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].

消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

S3 [底层物理/统计成因剖析 Root Cause Analysis]：Closer inspection indicates that this anomaly stems from [Specific Structural/External Factor] rather than random variance.
S4 [方法论启示 Methodological Implication]：Accounting for such localized departures is critical when calibrating [Downstream Model/Policy].

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的第一段（Introduction）：彻底扔掉 'With the rapid development of science and technology, more and more people...' 等烂大街模板，用 3 句话写出考官眼前一亮的母语级破题段。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP33` 与全文样板 `FT08` 的后半部分（`BP42 -> BP22 -> BP44`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Some works also use frequency domain like us, such as FEDformer and TimesNet. But our method is much better and more novel because we use a new module.
structural_constraints: S1 [具象现象锚定 Concrete Trend Anchor]：直接从具体技术变革或制度调整切入（如 Generative AI tools now draft code and summarize literature across university campuses），绝不用 With the development of...。
S2 [核心争议张力 Core Tension / Debate]：While proponents argue that [View A: efficiency/accessibility], critics warn that [View B: skill erosion/inequality].

S3 [带条件的中心论点 Nuanced Thesis Statement]：In my view, rather than banning [X] outright or adopting it uncritically, [Institution/Society] should [Core Stance], because [Primary Reason 1] and [Primary Reason 2].
